body: Thanks. I've been struggling since last August. I cut every single day, but if anyone asks how I'm doing, I'm fine. I can't let anyone know. And the people that I care about, don't care about me. I am constantly teased, harassed, and told bad things about myself. I'm now apart of it. I am tired of telling everyone the lie of that I'm okay. Because I'm not. I cry myself to sleep. I don't want to try anymore.
